about: PhaseBanner — a quiet strip above the site header saying what state the site is in (a prototype, a beta) and, optionally, where you are and one line of context. It sits above SiteHeader (SiteHeader's

label.about: What state the site is in, in a word or two: Prototype, Beta, Preview, Staging. Shown as an eyebrow, first, because it is the one thing every reader needs before they trust anything below it.

title.about: Where you are, when that helps: the page or route. Optional.

children.about: One line of context: what this is, or where feedback goes. Keep it to a sentence; a banner that needs two is a page.

sticky.about: Stay at the top of the viewport while the page scrolls. Default true.

live.about: Announce changes to the title or text politely (the banner is a status region). Default true; turn it off when the banner never changes.
